facts.fact: The Vice President said LHIMS was deployed in about 481 health facilities (teaching, regional, district, polyclinic and psychiatric hospitals) across all 16 regions, with over 1,000 health centres deployment ongoing.
The application integrates protocols from Ghana's Disease Surveillance Unit and gives timely access to epidemic information, per the Vice President.

systems.tiers: teaching, regional, district, polyclinic and psychiatric hospitals; health centres ongoing
